description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
Su-Chi Cave Guard enters the battlefield, triggering Blasting Station, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard.
Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, adding eight {C}.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
